assign.request: Test the md pages with a demo in ext/markdown. Where does a clicked markdown link open — one column deep vs three? No targeting system: the page decides (navigate, next column, or swap in place). Card folders list their own .md and open them by the card's rule. (relayed by servex-mastermind-opus)
assign.now: scoping — reading how columns and clicks work
steps: Tell the sibling masterminds the plan

log.msg: Interrupt: the owner reported /framework/ext/Panel/md/doc/decisions/ doesn't scroll. The cause was not md/. ai2/ai2.css had `.pages:has(> .page--ai2) { overflow-y: hidden }`, which kept matching after you left AI 2 (the page stays in the DOM, hidden), so every page opened after AI 2 in that tab was frozen. Read from the owner's own tab (2605x1185): framework .pages overflow-y hidden, one matching rule. Reproduced headless: ai2 → md doc → Router page, both stuck at scrollTop 0 on live.

decision.question: How to scope AI 2's hidden outer scrollbar
options: Remove the rule, bringing back the two scrollbars the owner complained about on AI 2
decision.why: AI 2 keeps its single scrollbar; every other page gets its gutter back the moment AI 2 is not on screen.

log.msg: Fixed in worktree/md-scroll (b5641864), merged under hold --paths ai2/**. Live after merge: md doc scrolls 1200, Router page 918, AI 2 still hidden:0. Zero failed requests. Told ai2-dashboard and live-card, who both have uncommitted ai2.css edits in other hunks. Posted one line on card live. Keyboard scroll (PageDown) doesn't move ANY page until the scroll region has focus — site-wide and older than this change, left as is.
core-columns replied: their changes are CSS only (Page.css, ext/Doc CSS); no overlap with open_link()/render lines. Go ahead.

assign.now: plan sent to core-columns and live-card; asking card-folders how a card is built

decision.question: Who decides where a clicked markdown link opens?
options: The page that holds the link: one seam, open_link(link), which a page overrides
A target on the link, like HTML's
decision.why: A doc's links stay plain markdown and read correctly in a normal page, in columns and in a card. A target makes every link author know the layout, and it breaks when the page moves.
decision.rule: the mastermind's pick, relayed from the owner's question

decision.question: In columns, does a doc open through the md/ route (an extra Markdown list column) or directly as the next column?
options: Directly: the doc is added as the clicked page's own child, headed by its file name
Through <page>/md/<doc>/: an extra folder-list column before every doc
decision.why: One click adds one column. A doc in a subfolder still goes through md/.

decision.question: What does a page call the folder its own docs live in?
options: folder: (a new field) read by md_dir()
source: taken, because core/Layout/layouts.js already uses source: as data
decision.chose: folder, behind an md_dir() method a card can override
decision.why: card-folders: a card's url (/framework/ai2/…) is a view of a folder elsewhere (its jsonl_url).

assign.outcome:
**A clicked markdown link now opens where the page that holds it decides: navigate, next column, or swapped in place.** The same three links opened three ways, live: [/framework/ext/markdown/open/](/framework/ext/markdown/open/).

![a card swapping a doc in place](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/md-open/swap.png)

- **No targeting system.** A link carries no target. The Router hands every in-app click to the page holding the link, which answers through one method, `open_link(link)`.
- **The default navigates** to the doc's own page. **A page in columns** opens a doc from its own folder as the next column: one column deep opens column two, three deep opens column four. **A card** adds one line and swaps the doc in place, with a Back button.
- **At 1280**, three deep plus the doc no longer fits, so the row scrolls the first column off to the left, and the crumb trail keeps the whole path. Both depths are shown side by side, live, at half size:

![one deep and three deep at 1280](/framework/ai/2026-09-24/md-open/depths.png)

- **Cards:** the seam is on michael/dev; task-mastermind-card-folders is adding the two lines to `Card.js` (list its own `.md` files, swap in place).
- **Told first:** core-columns (CSS only, no overlap) and live-card (its width rule governs only the Live card).

**Also fixed on the way:** pages stopped scrolling after AI 2 had been open in the same tab. An `ai2.css` rule kept hiding the scrollbar after you left AI 2; it now applies only while AI 2 is on screen.

**Left, one line each:**
- A swap has no url, so Back and reload don't restore it.
- A deep reload of a column doc logs one `page.js` 404 (the old fallback's cost; a click never does).
- The markdown Overview's deliberate "not written yet" demo still logs its own 404.

Doc: [core/Page/doc/open.md](/framework/core/Page/md/doc/open/)
